title: tasks.todo@1 (item kind): data
description: A to-do that waits on the person (inventory T2, Haystack P5): urgent (a P1), an overdue wait on someone outside, or its ticket finished. Attention, not consent: it offers done and snooze (the client computes until, e.g. tomorrow 9am); Later is client-local. Changing the wait itself is the To-dos mod's, in a full client.
